description: UCM + China intl + strong RD (no highSchoolLocation)
rationale: UCM uses a high Tier 1 academic anchor; combined with counselor v1.6 (origin/main) intl/OOS adjustments and Phase C gpaDistribution + ED/EA + ACT bands modifiers, the served output is ~0.87 for a strong China intl SAT 1500 applicant. UCM admits ~85% intl per IPEDS, so a strong applicant landing in the high 80s is consistent with 'less-selective school = essentially admit'. Range [0.84, 0.92] guards this behavior post-merge of counselor v1.6 + Phase C math.
